plugins.name: zcode-pipeline
plugins.description: Multi-agent development conveyor for ZCode: initializer -> briefer -> architect -> tech lead -> tech writer -> developer -> reviews (security/goal/code) -> QA -> manager -> summarizer; analysis track (analyst + /analyze), fast-track profile (/fast), coordinator skill, /init-project, /self-test, /pipeline-status and 12 safe git workflow commands (/git-status, /git-commit, /git-pull, /git-push, /git-fetch, /git-rebase, /git-squash, /git-push-force, /git-resolve, /git-undo, /git-stash, /git-branch): plan first, explicit confirmation for remote and destructive actions, --force-with-lease only.
